<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const papersHistoryList = document.getElementById('papers-history-list');
  if (!papersHistoryList) return;

  function updatePapersHistory() {
    let history = [];
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem('affinedrift_papers_history');
      if (raw) history = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (!Array.isArray(history)) history = [];
    } catch (e) {
      localStorage.removeItem('affinedrift_papers_history');
    }
    
    const currentPage = {
      title: document.title.replace(' - AffineDrift', '').replace('AffineDrift - ', ''),
      url: window.location.pathname.substring(window.location.pathname.lastIndexOf("/") + 1) || 'resources-papers.html'
    };

    if (currentPage.url === 'resources-papers.html') {
      history = history.filter(item => item.url !== currentPage.url);
      history.unshift(currentPage);
      history = history.slice(0, 10);
      localStorage.setItem('affinedrift_papers_history', JSON.stringify(history));
    }

    if (history.length === 0) {
      papersHistoryList.textContent = '';
      const li = document.createElement('li');
      li.className = 'history-empty';
      li.textContent = 'No recent papers yet';
      papersHistoryList.appendChild(li);
      return;
    }

    papersHistoryList.textContent = '';
    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
    history.forEach((item) => {
      const li = document.createElement("li");
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      let safeUrl = "#";
      if (typeof item.url === "string") {
        try {
          const parsed = new URL(item.url, window.location.origin);
          if (parsed.protocol === "http:" || parsed.protocol === "https:") {
            safeUrl = parsed.href;
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      a.href = safeUrl;
      a.textContent = item.title;
      li.appendChild(a);
      fragment.appendChild(li);
    });
    papersHistoryList.appendChild(fragment);
  }

  updatePapersHistory();
});
</script>
